buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Generic Registration / Empanelment Requirement: Contract shall be awarded to only such sellers , who are registered / empanelled / approved / enlisted with EPF,ESIC,GST,MINISTRY OF LABOUR FOR LABOUR LICENSE for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid opening date. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reasonable procedure.) 3. Purchase Preference (Centre) Bid reserved for Make In India products: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Class 1 local suppliers as defined in public procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 as amended from time to time and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Nodal Ministry for specific Goods/Products. The minimum local content to qualify as a class 1 local supplier is denoted in the bid document 50%. All bidders must upload a certificate from the OEM regarding the percentage of the local content and the details of locations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. In case the bid value is more than Rs 10 Crore, the declaration relating to percentage of local content shall be certified by the statutory auditor or cost auditor, if the OEM is a company and by a practicing cost accountant or a chartered accountant for OEMs other than companies as per the Public Procurement (preference to Make-in -India) order 2017 dated 04.06.2020 . In case Buyer has selected Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises clause in the bid, the same will get precedence over this clause. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of MUNITIONS INDIA LIMITED_HIGH EXPLOSIVES FACTORY payable at KHADKI,PUNE-411003 . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C MUNITIONS INDIA LIMITED_HIGH EXPLOSIVES FACTORY,KHADKI,PUNE-411003. . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. . Additional Terms and Conditions. i. Bidders have to go through the Scope of Work / Specification of the bid. On participation / submiss ion of quotation against the bid means that the firm complies to the Scope of work / Specification of t he bid. In case of any non-compliance to the Scope of Work / Specification, the bidder have to specif y the same in the bid. ii. The job is to be carried out as per HEF specification as attached in the bid. The job is to be carried out strictly as per specifications. iii. Being Defence installation, it is very important that people having access to this office should hav e good character and antecedents. Only PVR cleared individual will be accepted and allowed to work . The same, in original, to be submitted in security section. iv. The short term hiring of human resource on full-time basis will be purely on contractual basis and this appointment will not vest any right to claim by the candidate for regular appointment in the fact ory or automatic extension of contract / agreement. v. Residential Facility – not entitled. vi. Medical Facility – not entitled for medical treatment at O.F. Hospital. vii. During the validity of the agreement, the same may be terminated, by CGM/HEF, by giving a prior 07 days’ notice. Hence, the Chief General Manager being the competent authority reserves the right to terminate the services to any or all the contract employees prematurely without assigning any re asons thereto. viii. Contractor shall replace the working personal immediately if Factory finds him/her otherwise not s uitable. ix. Factory shall not be the party to any kind of dispute that may arise between the contractor and co ntractual individual to be engaged by them. x. The contractor shall abide by the provisions of the child labours (prohibition and regulation act 19 86). xi. The contractor shall not pay wages less than the prevailing minimum wages as fixed by central go vt. from time to time during the currency of the contract, to the workers engaged by them. Minimum wages shall mean the rate(s) notified by central government from time to time. The contractor shall maintain necessary records and register like wage book and wage slip, register of unpaid wages and register of fines and deductions mentioning the relevant particulars as required under various statut ory provisions. xii. The contractor will be liable for making any compensation which may arise in case of any accident to person employed by him against this contract as per ESI schedule. For minor injury while on work financial/medical help shall immediately be given by the contractor. xiii. Payment to be made to the contract labour on regular basis on or before 7th of every month as it is a statutory requirement & other statutory requirement should be met as per new labour laws. An y violation of the statutory requirement will lead to cancellation of contract without any advance inti mation and the PSD will be forfeited. xiv. Any damage caused to the properties and works of HEF by the contractor during his period shall be made good / adequately compensated by the contractor, failing which the same will be made good by the GM/HEF at the risk and cost of the contractor. xv. The contractor will not allow or permit his employees to participate in any trade union activities or agitation anywhere in the work place/premises of HEF. If found indulging in such activities, the contr act labour will be terminated immediately. xvi. Sub-letting of contract is not allowed. xvii. The contractors will have to take out the following insurance policies to cover up all the risk and ke ep them valid till the successful completion of the contract. Ø Work man’s compensation Ø Risk / liability of the 3rd party the same to be submitted to HEF. xviii. The contractor has to submit the bill along with the following documents for claiming payment (a). Contract Bill as per the format – 2 copies (2)Firm’s Invoice – 4 copies (3).Wage Sheet (From-B) with c ontract labour signature in revenue stamp as per the latest format which may be taken from interne t – 2 copies(4).Net banking statement for the payment made to the contract which must reflect the n ame of the individual contract labour for proof of payment made- 2 copies. (5).EPF, ESI payment chal lan along with individual contract labours contribution list to be attached – 2 copies. (6).GST challan

– 2 copies. (7).Professional Tax challan – 2 copies (8).Net banking statement for payment made for E PF, ESI, GST, Professional Tax etc. – 2 copies (9).Mandate Form / Cancelled Cheque for account detai ls in which payment to be made – 2 copies. xix. Performance Security Deposit (PSD) equal to 5% value of the supply order value or any revision th ereof to be submitted within 30 days of time from the date of supply order placement by the contrac tor. Only after submission of PSD, Bills submitted by the contractor will be cleared. xx. TDS will be deducted at applicable rate (existing of Govt. levy) before disposing of the bills submit ted by the contractor for payment. xxi. In case of any changes in the minimum wages as per the Applicable Laws during the contract perio d, Buyer shall pay the Service Provider the difference in wage from the amount mentioned in the con tract on pro rate basis. xxii. The Contractor has to abide by Factory Act and Payment of wages act for deployment of contract l abours. xxiii. The Chief General Manager/HEF has the right to short close/cancel the service contract at any sta ge till the quantity /service completed after notice to the contractor. xxiv. Firm shall abide the all the terms and conditions as per MILSPM 2023 & GeM portal. xxv. All GeM Sellers/Service providers shall ensure full compliance with all applicable labour laws, inclu ding the provisions, rules, schemes and guidelines under the four labour codes i.e. the code on wag es ,2019;the industrial Relations Code, 2020; The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditio ns Code,2020;and the Code on Social Security,2020 .All obligations relating to wages ,social security , safety, working conditions, industrial relation etc. and any other statutory requirements shall be str ictly met by the Seller/Servicer Provider.Any non-compliance shall constitute a breach of the contrac t and shall entitle the buyer(HEF) to take appropriate action in accordance with the contract and app licable law.
